draft.shortGloss: to drink; to swallow a liquid
draft.emotion: relaxed and refreshed, the satisfying feeling of quenching one's thirst
notes: Used for consuming any liquid. For an A2 learner, it is helpful to remember that while 'กิน' (kin) is used for eating food, 'ดื่ม' (dùm) is specifically for liquids, similar to the distinction between 'eat' and 'drink' in English.
